probes.name: full_query_response_binding
probes.interpretation: Checks CMS signature, timestamp certificate path, subject message imprint, and the request nonce.

probes.name: correct_digest_without_query
probes.interpretation: Digest-only verification succeeds but does not prove that this response answers the retained nonce-bearing request.

probes.name: cms_signature_and_chain_verification
probes.interpretation: The extracted CMS token signature and signer chain verify independently of the higher-level timestamp query check.

probes.name: wrong_subject_digest_rejected
probes.interpretation: The signed message imprint cannot be rebound to a different enrollment digest.

probes.name: different_nonce_query_rejected
probes.interpretation: A query for the same digest but a different nonce is not the request answered by this response.

probes.name: tampered_der_rejected
probes.interpretation: A one-bit mutation of the DER response is rejected.

probes.name: attacker_tsa_rejected_by_pinned_root
probes.interpretation: A syntactically and cryptographically valid timestamp from an untrusted private TSA is rejected by the pinned honest root.
stderr_tail: 100000000A000000:error:17800064:time stamp routines:ts_verify_cert:certificate verify error:crypto/ts/ts_rsp_verify.c:190:Verify error:self-signed certificate in certificate chain

probes.name: attacker_tsa_accepted_if_attacker_root_is_trusted
probes.interpretation: Cryptographic validity is relative to the configured trust anchor; accepting a self-appointed root destroys independent-witness semantics.

probes.name: wrong_eku_certificate_rejected_for_timestamp_purpose
probes.interpretation: A certificate that chains correctly but is authorized only for code signing is not a valid TSA certificate.
stderr_tail: CN=ACSD v1.3.3 WRONG EKU TEST CERT, OU=NOT FOR PRODUCTION
error 26 at 0 depth lookup: unsuitable certificate purpose

probes.name: tsa_certificate_has_timestamp_signing_purpose
probes.interpretation: The signer certificate chains to the pinned root and has the RFC 3161 timestamp-signing purpose.
